name: EIBOS (Shenzhen EIBOS Chuanggou Tech Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen company best known for filament dryers (Easdry, Tetras, Cyclopes, Polyphemus) and resin cleaner, which also sells PLA+ and silk PLA+ filament through its Amazon 'EIBOS Official Store'. Active since early 2020. The filament's extruder is not identified.

product_lines.name: PLA+ Silk Ribbon / Tri-Color Silk Ribbon

additional_notes: Legal entity named as manufacturer on an Amazon product listing and on a Rapid + TCT exhibitor page. As a dryer company its filament is probably OEM-sourced, but there is no evidence of the source, so no relationship is recorded. EIBOS dryers are resold by West3D and 3DPrintergear AU (not a filament relationship). Do not confuse with eSUN.

provenance.conflicts: Identity medium, filament sourcing low. The 'active since early 2020' date comes from a search snippet. A 3dwithus article links an 'Official Website' that was not retrieved, so no website endpoint is recorded.
